symptom: MCP error -32001 pri tool_git_status_all/tool_cross_repo_search; audit duration_s 61.7-62.4 s (>60 s client timeout).
root_cause: Serieova iterace 14 repozitaru v jedne smycce (14 x 4.4 s).
fix: ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) -> ~15 s.

symptom: tool_git_diff error az po 60 s (30 s subprocess + 30 s client = dvojite cekani).
root_cause: Subprocess timeout (30 s) prilis blizko client timeoutu (60 s).
fix: Subprocess timeout <=15 s — fail fast.

symptom: git status/git diff trvaly 3-5 s na read-only operaci.
root_cause: Git implicitne zapisuje .git/index.lock; chybel --no-optional-locks.
fix: ['git', '--no-optional-locks', ...] ve vsech subprocess volanich.

symptom: tool_session_state failuje 'str' object has no attribute 'get'.
root_cause: .ai_state.json obsahoval string misto dict; v.get() pada na non-dict.
fix: isinstance(v, dict) check + auto-repair mechanismus.

symptom: Bez audit logu nelze identifikovat zdroj timeoutu (seda zona subprocess/client timeout).
root_cause: Zadna per-tool duration telemetrie.
fix: @auditable dekorator na vsech tool funkcich; povinne ts, tool, duration_s, ok.

symptom: print(text.encode('utf-8')) vypsal b'...' misto text — binary repr misto stringu.
root_cause: Python 3: print() na bytes neiva ASCII repr; nebo encoding retezce na bytes bez dekodovani.
fix: print(text.encode('utf-8').decode('utf-8')) — hex dump approach; nebo rovnou print(text).

symptom: subprocess.run() sdilil stdout/stderr handle mezi parent a child procesem — data ztracena nebo duplikovana.
root_cause: Handle inheritance: child process zdedil parent stdout/stderr.
fix: subprocess.run(..., capture_output=True) nebo explicitni PIPE.

symptom: Playwright error: expected BrowserContext got Browser — nespravna instance.
root_cause: Typova zamena: page.context = BrowserContext, ne Browser. Volano na spatne triede.
fix: Pouzit page.context misto page.browser().

symptom: LinkedIn cookie vyprsi bez varovani — session pada uprostred scrape.
root_cause: Cookie lifecycle: LinkedIn session cookie ma TTL ~30 dni; bez monitorovani = ticha expirace.
fix: Cookie expiry check pri startupu + refresh protokol.

symptom: Salary parsing selhava na ruznych formatech: '25 000-30 000 Kc', '15EUR/h', 'negotiable'.
root_cause: Regex nepadla na regionalni formaty (mezerova cisla, jednotky, cestina).
fix: Multi-pattern regex + fallback na 'negotiable' marker.

symptom: Scraping vracel empty results na ceskych portalech bez erroru.
root_cause: 6-layer encoding stack: HTTP charset -> HTML meta -> actual bytes -> regex -> output -> LLM prompt. Kazda vrstva muze kazyt encoding.
fix: Explicitni encoding na kazde vrstve + ASCII konverze pro cross-layer kompatibilitu.

symptom: Cerebras vraci 200 OK, ale message.content je None -> pipeline pada do fallback/raw JSON dumpu.
root_cause: Cerebras pouziva proprietarni reasoning field misto standardniho content.
fix: Fallback chain v parseru (viz P30).

symptom: Uzivatel nevi, ktere providery cascade zkusila a ktery vyhral.
root_cause: Cascade log vracen jen ve variantě with_logs; stav provideru neni nikde perzistentni.
fix: Log paralelne s reportem; header uvadi provider/model/tokens/cost/latency.

symptom: 5 her = 24 min; 99.9 % casu Stockfish (deterministicky krok).
root_cause: Zadna cache — Stockfish analyza se opakovala pri kazdem spusteni.
fix: Cache-first: check data/game_cache/{game_id}...json (depth-gated) -> hit = reuse, miss = analyze+store. Re-run 5 her = 0.1 s.

symptom: _build_game_prompt generoval prazdny nebo nesmyslny prompt — low SNR v LLM vystupu.
root_cause: Spatne klice v dict: code cital 'opening_name' misto 'opening'.
fix: Pouzit reatributy modelu, ne getattr s defaultem (P63).

symptom: Po oprave kodu se cachechovala star data — BFS stale obsahoval predchozi chyby.
root_cause: Zadna cache invalidace po code change — stare zaznamy zustavaly v cache.
fix: detector_version v cache klicich; version mismatch -> re-analyze.

symptom: ruff --fix smazal importy potrebne pro beh — F401 desike shell execution.
root_cause: Side-effect importy bez # noqa: F401; ruff --fix je destruktivni bez review.
fix: Side-effect importy s # noqa: F401 + po ruff --fix vzdy git diff + registracni smoke check.

symptom: LLM prompt obsahoval garbage data z neexistujicich atributu — falesna autorita.
root_cause: getattr s defaultem na LLM response bez signalizace kvality.
fix: Reaalna pole modelu + color-aware win_rate + evaluation_errors marker.

sub_bugs.description: getattr garbage — neexistujici atributy s defaultem
hardcoded perspektiva — analyzoval vlastni tahy jako oponentovy
cache kolize barev — klic bez barvy
timeout kill reference — sdruseny engine misto volajiciho

symptom: GitHub GUI zobrazoval 02_ANALYZY jako mojibake; 20 trackovanych ne-ASCII nazvu v 6 repech.
root_cause: Encoding dluh — git uklada path jako raw bytes; U+2011 vizualne identicky s - ale jiny codepoint.
fix: Konvence ASCII-NOM [A-Za-z0-9._-] + transliterace + .scripts/ascii_filenames_check.ps1 + context_refs_check.py validator.

symptom: Salary data obsahovaly Unicode en-dash (U+2013) misto hyphen-minus — ticha data korekce v regex matchu.
root_cause: Regionálni formaty: en-dash a hyphen-minus vizualne identicne, ale jiny codepoint.
fix: Unicode-aware parsing + DB audit, ne vizualni kontrola kody.

symptom: gcloud commands vracely 403 Forbidden i po nastaveni IAM roli.
root_cause: 5-vrstva auth stack: IAM role -> Access Scope -> Metadata Server -> Workspace vs Cloud -> SA quota. Nejcastejsi selhavani: vrstva 2 nebo 4.
fix: Postupna diagnostika pres 5 vrstev; nejcastejsi: access scopes nebo workspace/cloud mismatch.

symptom: Opakovane selhavani v GCP infrastrukture bez progresu — kognitivni preteceni.
root_cause: Prilis mnoho soucasnych problemu = analyticka paraliza.
fix: Hard Reset protokol: smazat poskozeny soubor -> vlozit overeny blok -> smazat data -> zacit z nuly.
